# Use runtime database URL for migrations

The Alembic migration routines obtain the database URL at runtime by calling knowledge_compiler.storage.db.database_url() (the module docstring indicates this comes from KC_DATABASE_URL) rather than hardcoding a URL.

Ensure migrations always use the environment-driven/centralized database configuration (KC_DATABASE_URL) so the migration target is controlled at runtime and not embedded in code.

**Anchored to:**

- `alembic/env.py` — `alembic.env.run_migrations_offline`
- `alembic/env.py` — `alembic.env.run_migrations_online`

- [knowledge_compiler.storage.schema](../component/knowledge-compiler-storage-schema.md)
